blocks.text: Jhoanna Robles of P-pop girl group BINI turned her personal wardrobe into a fundraising effort as she held a closet sale for charity over the weekend. Robles spearheaded the charity event on Oct. 3 in Mandaluyong City, where she met fans who registered for the sale. The attendees took to social media to give a glimpse of the closet sale. The singer sold pieces from her personal collection, including brand-new clothes and pre-loved pieces. Each purchase also came with a photocard featuring the girl group member wearing the item.
